backbone_mapping_validation: atomic number, intra-residue bonds and peptide connectivity
global_fit: all common CA atoms; unweighted least squares
domain_fit: each domain independently fitted to itself
Rg: all protein atoms; mass weighted; unfitted coordinates
rmsf: CA atoms after global fit; population variance
domain_rmsf: Each domain fitted independently to its native reference on every frame; RMSF about its own time-average coordinates, population variance. Compare with global-fit RMSF descriptively; their difference is not an additive decomposition of motions.
